dialog.mail.data_hint: The values of the form fields as they are now.
dialog.mail.data_protected: The document is protected, and its data would be attached as plain text that anyone could read: it is not attached. Attach the document itself, which stays protected.
dialog.mail.fail_attach: The mail program could not take the files
dialog.mail.fail_no_program: No mail program takes messages from Folitecta
dialog.mail.fail_refused: The mail program answered with an error
dialog.mail.failed: {reason}. Save the draft and open it with your mail program, or attach the files from their folder.
dialog.mail.failed_item: This file could not be prepared: {reason}
dialog.mail.left_out: Left out with the other pages: {list}.
dialog.mail.left_xfa: the XFA form data, which held the values of those fields too
dialog.mail.mac_hint: Mail receives only the files: type the subject and the message there.
dialog.mail.name: File name
dialog.mail.not_protected: This copy could not be protected like the document, so it is not attached.
dialog.mail.nothing: Choose at least one file to attach.
dialog.mail.opened: A new message opened in your mail program. Check that it has the {count} files before you send it; if any is missing, save the draft or attach them from their folder.
dialog.mail.protected_locked: Protected with a password: its pages are shown once the file is opened with it.
dialog.mail.rc4_twice: This document is protected with the older RC4 method: attaching two versions of it would let a reader compare them and weaken the protection. Attach only one.
dialog.mail.read_failed: The file could not be read: {reason}
dialog.mail.save_hint: A draft (.eml) is an unsent message with the files attached: open it with your mail program to send it.
dialog.mail.saved_hint: The saved file is attached as it is, without the changes made after it was saved; its pages and comments cannot be chosen.
dialog.mail.saved_plain: The saved file is not protected like the document: it is not attached. Save the document again, then attach it.
dialog.mail.signed_update: The changes are an update of the signed file: what was removed after signing is still in its earlier version.
dialog.mail.status_failed: Files that cannot be attached: {count}. Leave them out or change them.
dialog.mail.subject: Subject
dialog.mail.summary: {count} files, {size} in total. Nothing is sent: you send the message from your mail program.
dialog.mail.summary_zip: One ZIP archive with {count} files, {size}. Nothing is sent: you send the message from your mail program.
dialog.mail.title: E-mail Attachments
dialog.mail.wait: The files are still being prepared.
dialog.mail.warn_signatures: A changed or protected copy is written whole, which would leave its signatures invalid, so they were removed from it. To send the signed document, attach the saved file with every page and its comments.
